name: dante-dev
description: Development entry point for DANTE — orchestrates the Python backend (uv) and the UI packages (npm)

scripts.setup: uv sync --extra server --extra dev && npm --prefix ui/web install && npm --prefix ui/desktop install
scripts.setup:full: uv sync --all-extras && npm --prefix ui/web install && npm --prefix ui/desktop install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "uv run python -m triforce.server" "npm --prefix ui/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix ui/web run build && npm --prefix ui/desktop run build
